parsed.rationale: The eight participating records span four unrelated packages (Playback, DebugPanel, Wallpaper, Intents) and represent domain-distinct types (IntentError, TimeoutError, PlaybackState, PlayerState, StreamingAudioState, PlaybackError, ProcessInfo.ThermalState) whose only shared structural signal is that every fields_or_signature list is empty — i.e., they are all zero-member extensions or type aliases. The 'exact duplicate' match is purely coincidental shape overlap, not shared semantics. Additionally, one record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which falls under the Examples/ path and triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint. Merging or extracting these types would couple unrelated domain concepts and cross package boundaries without any real deduplication benefit.
